verdict.rationale: The docs describe agents (Kosmos, Precedent, Falcon-style literature search) that query FutureHouse's own indexed corpus of 175M+ papers, and Kosmos can take 'one or more datasets' as scientific data inputs (e.g., flow cytometry, RNA-seq), but there is no evidence of a user-facing feature to upload one's own PDFs or a custom literature corpus for the agent to search/reason over.
